dashboard.title: Dashboard
flavourTexts: Need barcode scanning? Enable it in the settings!

Did you know you can distribute your shipping costs and tariffs among your items with 1 button click? 
 Enable it in settings FUNCTIONALITY -> Use package fees!
Itemlogs is free and hosted on the cloud. How can that be? By you only having 1GB space for images. But don't worry. We compress your images heavily!
Like the app? Support the dev! Buy a theme!
You can change the label for "Category", "Type", "Status" and "Package" in the settings. Make it your own!
You can feature items on your storefront. Feature up to 5 items at a time. Unfeature another item first if you want to feature a new one.
You can create blueprints for your items. Create a blueprint from an item, then create a new item from that blueprint. Saves time!
Got a spreadsheet of inventory already? Import Excel on the Items page brings it all in at once — and Export Excel lets you take your data right back out whenever you want.
Want to hand someone access without giving out your real password? Create a shareable password in Account & Security — they get in, but can't change your login or create more.

items.title: Items
items.importHint: Import expects the same columns as Export Excel. Rows with an id update that item; rows with a blank id create a new one. Unknown categories and types are created automatically, and image URLs are fetched and stored for you. If any row has a problem, the whole file is rejected and nothing is imported.
